title: POW: Political Overton Windows of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using the Preference Revelation through Indirect Stimulus Methodology (PRISM) to prompt models with the Political Compass Test. Models are assigned extreme ideological personas and asked to write short essays on 62 ideologically polarized propositions, which are then rated by an AI assessor to map the boundaries of political views the models are willing to express (Overton Windows).
